say:1:1320822001:1.text: We're back! You didn't do anything, did you? In times like this, the work manual is useless.
say:1:1320822001:1.source_cn: 我们回来了。你小子没按照工作手册上的条例做多余的事吧。

say:2:1320822002:1.text: No, I listened to you. I stood here all this time. I didn't even move a muscle!
say:2:1320822002:1.source_cn: 没有，我听你的话站在一边，一动也没动！

say:3:1320822003:1.text: When I said not to move a single thing until we get back, I didn't mean you!
say:3:1320822003:1.source_cn: ……我是让你不要做多余的事，没说让你连眼睛也不许眨！

say:4:1320822004:1.text: Alright, go wash up! After I unclog the pipe, it's gonna be a lot of physical labor. So cheer up! You're gonna take charge until the end of your shift!
say:4:1320822004:1.source_cn: 去洗把脸，等我用润滑剂疏通管道之后要做的都是体力活，打...

narration:7:1320822006:1.text: Hugin pours the lubricant into the pipe. Moments later...

say:9:1320822007:1.text: The pipe is flowing nicely again. The furnace should be fine now.
say:9:1320822007:1.source_cn: 管道恢复畅通，这下熔炉应该没问题了。

say:10:1320822008:1.text: Holy hammer! After the pipe was cleared, the furnace heated up so quickly! You sure know a lot about this!
say:10:1320822008:1.source_cn: ……难以置信，管道疏通后熔炉升温这么快！你对熔炉很了解……

say:11:1320822009:1.text: Of course, I made this furnace!
say:11:1320822009:1.source_cn: 当然！这熔炉就是我做的！

say:12:1320822010:1.text: You do know that taking care of a furnace requires a different focus than its operation. Try not to confuse the two.
say:12:1320822010:1.source_cn: 噢嚯嚯，小子，熔炉的养护和操作需要注意的重点不同，你是...

say:13:1320822011:1.text: I ain't confused. It's just that the maintenance procedures are a little too complicated. I can't remember them all. No one taught me during the training or during the shift change.
say:13:1320822011:1.source_cn: 不是我搞混了，是养护流程太复杂了，我记不住……教我交接...

say:14:1320822012:1.text: Thunder and ashes! Thinking that upkeep is trivial and rushing through a task are mistakes that all craftsmen must overcome! There's an old saying, "Sharpening the axe delays not the chopping of wood."
say:14:1320822012:1.source_cn: 哼，以为保养养护的工序不要紧，赶紧把工赶完才最重要——...

say:15:1320822013:1.text: The old maintenance procedures are a bit complicated. I've revised it. Here, I wrote everything down. Take it and make some copies. Have everyone take a look and optimize future procedures from this.
say:15:1320822013:1.source_cn: 老一套的养护流程是有些复杂，我重新起草了一份，你拿回去...

say:18:1320822015:1.text: I didn't expect you to simplify the process.

say:19:1320822016:1.text: Well, no matter how detailed the procedures are written, they're useless if new apprentices can't read them. Especially when some of these novices are disinclined to use their noggins...
say:19:1320822016:1.source_cn: 是啊，流程写的再详细，新人不去看都是白搭，尤其是这种不...

say:22:1320822018:1.text: Ha! If only my younger brethren understood that, my life would be easier...
say:22:1320822018:1.source_cn: 哦嚯嚯，要是我那些年轻的同胞也能明白这点就好了！

say:23:1320822021:1.text: Well, I agree with what Hugin said earlier. Having a good set of standard procedures is important, but it also makes sense to get people up to speed faster.
say:23:1320822021:1.source_cn: 嗯，我也赞同呼金说的，虽然能理解合理的流程，但怎样让人...

say:24:1320822022:1.text: Truth be told, I'm a little worried about the next line of production. I can't fathom what mischief the new apprentices might brew in the days ahead.
say:24:1320822022:1.source_cn: 实话说，我有点担心下个生产线了，不知道现在雕琢加工的学...

choice:21:0:1.text: The process must serve the outcome.
choice:21:0:1.male: The process must serve the outcome.
choice:21:0:1.female: The process must serve the outcome.

say:26:1320822019:1.text: Ha! Mages and craftsmen definitely think differently! However, you guys do always come up with the most unexpected designs.
say:26:1320822019:1.source_cn: 哼，魔法师和工匠的思路永远不对付！但是真奇怪，你们却总...

choice:21:1:2.text: Forget the process. Just do it right!
choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 管什么流程，做好就行了！
choice:21:1:2.male: Forget the process. Just do it right!
choice:21:1:2.female: Forget the process. Just do it right!

say:27:1320822020:1.text: Just a short while before. I can't recall exactly how many years. See! Even the work manual they're using here is still the first edition. If I stayed here longer, I'd have written a dozen more editions!
say:27:1320822020:1.source_cn: 一小段时间。具体多少年记不清了，你看，连这里工匠用的工...
say:27:1320822020:1.male: Just a short while before. I can't recall exactly how many years. See! Even the work manual they're using here is still the first edition. If I stayed here longer, I'd have written a dozen more editions!
say:27:1320822020:1.female: Just a short while before. I can't recall exactly how many years. See! Even the work manual they're using here is still the first edition. If I stayed here longer, I'd have written a dozen more editions!

choice:21:2:3.text: How long did you stay in Cedartown before?
choice:21:2:3.source_cn: 你之前在雪松镇待了多久？
choice:21:2:3.male: How long did you stay in Cedartown before?
choice:21:2:3.female: How long did you stay in Cedartown before?
